source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: dataveillance OR "lateral surveillance" OR "social sorting" OR "state surveillance" OR "mass surveillance"
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:dataveillance OR "lateral surveillance" OR "social sorting" OR "state surveillance" OR "mass surveillance",is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("lateral surveillance" OR "mass surveillance" OR "social sorting" OR "state surveillance" OR "dataveillance")
